selinux_default.description: Whether to use SELinux features. 1 enables, 0 disables.

restart_syslog_default.description: Whether to restart syslog after link changes. 1 enables, 0 disables.

restart_cron_default.description: Whether to restart cron after link changes. 1 enables, 0 disables.

use_bind_mount_default.description: Whether to use bind mounts instead of symbolic links. 1 enables, 0 disables.

debug_default.description: Whether to log debugging information. 1 enables, 0 disables.

mountpoint_default.description: The mountpoint for the DRBD drive.

clean_this_config_default.description: Whether to preserve a copy of the config file for cleaning. 1 enables, 0 disables.
